ns2:section.sectionText: General Engineering students must obtain Chief Advisor approval (209 Trans Bldg) to drop after the second week of instruction. Course restricted to General Engineering majors the first 3 weeks of early enrollment. Course restricted to General Engineering and Mechanical Engineering majors after early enrollment. Students should register for one lecture and one lab section. Concurrent registration in GE 397, IE (CRN: 46583) required. Meets with IE 310.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to General Engineering or Mechanical Engineering major(s).
